case.summary: This case was triggered by an autonomous monitor flagging transaction 3589353 for $4.94 because a device profile was shared as a New device by 8 customers on card C11143-K1. Graph evidence showed the device profile had already been used 7 times on this card, and the transaction model scored the event at a very low 0.003. The cardholder was contacted and confirmed they made the purchase, aligning with a prior cleared alert on this account. The verdict is legitimate, and the final actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
